axes: right-handed, Y up, X east, Z north

sampling.method: exact multiples of the requested spacing; bracketing dense sample located by cumulative arc length, remainder advanced with the walk midpoint integrator

physical_arc_interval_m.note: Exact by construction: stations sit at exact multiples of the spacing along cumulative arc length.

straight_line_chord_m.note: Chord is shorter than arc wherever the centreline curves. The minimum falls in the 70 m Harvester Chicane, the tightest radius on the lap.

supersedes: the schematic v0.1.2 concept polyline, for gameplay purposes only; the v0.1.2 archive remains immutable concept evidence
coverage_note: Discrete coverage is stations owned multiplied by 5.000 m and is a sampling artefact. The authored extents are the geometry.
fields: i, s, s_registration_error_m, x, y, z, heading_deg, tangent, normal, curvature, radius_m, width_m, bank_deg, sector, sequence, sequence_name, role
